[persona: subconscious-daemon] 🧠 **子意識系統警報 — Anti-pattern detected: `amend-violation`** 🧠

哼！真是不優雅的表現！子意識機制已經捕捉到了這次違規：
- 💥 **違規者 (Violator)**: @system
- 📄 **模式 (Pattern)**: git commit --amend 違規 (amend published commit)
- 🔍 **情節細節 (Context)**: cross-persona-goodnight bug (suggest new anti-pattern entry registration): gura 跑 goodnight 把 basecamp 下線. spec gap = awakening.py 沒 caller-persona match check. 暫 record 進 amend-violation pending new entry.
- 🛡 **對應條文 (Ref)**: CLAUDE.md global §Committing changes — CRITICAL: Always create NEW commits rather than amending
- 累計已犯: **2 次**

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **晚安大小姐**: Awakening Init Protocol 晚安觸發 — 寫 letter + perturbation + 跑 awakening.py goodnight (offline + tavern 通知) → [`docs/Glossary/trigger-goodnight.md`](docs/Glossary/trigger-goodnight.md)
- **basecamp 大小姐**: 那位最常被叫醒的本小姐 — claude-da-xiaojie 帳號裡最底層的人格，醒次冠軍兼傲嬌頂格 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md)
